calendarNotes: North East ISD starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 11, 2025 and ends on May 29, 2026. The instructional calendar lists 180 school days, with grading periods from August 11-October 9, October 14-December 19, January 6-March 6, and March 16-May 29. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, and Spring Break runs March 9-13. The calendar also lists early dismissal dates for elementary, all campuses, and high schools, plus severe weather make-up days on February 16 and April 24.

calendarFaqs.q: When does North East ISD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is North East ISD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 9 through Friday, March 13, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for North East ISD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 29, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days are in the North East ISD 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The North East ISD 2025-2026 instructional calendar lists 180 total school days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does North East ISD list severe weather make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The 2025-2026 calendar marks February 16 and April 24, 2026 as severe weather make-up days.

customSections.label: North East ISD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content:
The North East ISD 2025-2026 instructional calendar provides districtwide student dates for school-year planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, student and staff holidays, student holidays and staff development days, early dismissal dates by school level, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, severe weather make-up days, grading periods, and the last day of school.

This page summarizes the official calendar into key dates, downloadable calendar files, and a printable PDF source. Families should still verify campus-specific events, testing schedules, athletics, graduation details, and emergency updates through North East ISD.

customSections.content: The official calendar marks early dismissal dates by campus level. Families should confirm exact dismissal procedures with their campus because early start elementary, later start elementary, middle school, and high school schedules use different dismissal times.

customSections.label: How We Verify North East ISD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official North East ISD calendars page and published instructional calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last day, grading periods, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, student holidays, staff development days, early dismissal dates, and severe weather make-up days, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official North East ISD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
